# fmt / float-fuzzer

fmt's own fuzz target `float-fuzzer` ([source](source/float.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over fmt (fmtlib/fmt at 21d4cc15).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: For the 8 input bytes read as a double v (non-NaN), strtod(format("{}", v)) must equal v (shortest round-trip repr) and likewise for "{:.50g}" (forces the fallback formatter).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against fmt at commit 21d4cc15.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- A NaN must format exactly as "nan" or "-nan" according to its sign bit ([line 19](source/float.cc#L19)): an uncaught exception; confirmed in the binary.
- For the 8 input bytes read as a double v (non-NaN), strtod(format("{}", v)) must equal v (shortest round-trip repr) and likewise for "{:.50g}" (forces the fallback formatter) ([line 26](source/float.cc#L26)): an uncaught exception; confirmed in the binary.
- strtod must consume the whole formatted output (no trailing unparsed characters) ([line 28](source/float.cc#L28)): an uncaught exception; confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch fmt` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
